name: junco
description: Recursive Pi agencies: typed work graphs paired with composable scheduling policies.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/dataflow-engine build && bun run --cwd packages/junco-tools build && bun run --cwd packages/junco-mcp build && bun run --cwd packages/junco-agent build && bun run --cwd packages/junco-scheduler build && bun run --cwd packages/dataflow-engine-opik build && bun run --cwd packages/dataflow-profile build && bun run build:lib
scripts.build:lib: bun build ./src/index.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --packages external --splitting --sourcemap=external && bun build ./src/optimizer-cli.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm --packages external --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:examples: bun build ./examples/recursive-agency/recursive-agency.ts ./examples/mixed/mixed.ts ./examples/oss-committee/oss-committee.ts ./examples/mcp/mcp.ts ./examples/yak-shaver/yak-shaver.ts ./examples/verus/verus.ts ./examples/camel/camel.ts --root ./examples --outdir ./examples/dist --target bun --format esm --packages bundle --splitting --sourcemap=external --env=disable --external junco-tools/native --external @earendil-works/pi-agent-core --external @earendil-works/pi-ai --external @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
scripts.install:marsh: node packages/junco-tools/scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs cargo install --path crates/marsh --locked --bin rmux --root "$HOME/.local" && printf 'Installed %s\n' "$HOME/.local/bin/rmux" && case ":$PATH:" in *":$HOME/.local/bin:"*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ;; esac
scripts.test:junco-policy: node packages/junco-tools/scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs cargo test --locked --workspace --manifest-path crates/junco-policy/Cargo.toml && node packages/junco-tools/scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path crates/junco-policy/fuzz/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.fuzz:junco-policy: cd crates/junco-policy && node ../../packages/junco-tools/scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs cargo +nightly fuzz run lock_policy -- -max_total_time=60
scripts.postinstall: if [ -x "${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/junco-tools/cargo}/bin/cargo" ]; then cd packages/junco-tools && bun run build:native; else echo 'postinstall: no Rust toolchain for junco-tools (see packages/junco-tools/README.md); skipped its native addon' >&2; fi
